capabilities: Add, edit and delete accounts and transactions through modals
Display net worth, expense and income vs. expense dashboards with charts
Track savings goals and monthly expense limits
Filter transactions by account wildcards, tags and date ranges
Export table data to CSV or Markdown PDFs
extras: The README states the plugin was entirely generated by Google Gemini models in Antigravity, and recommends installing via the BRAT beta-testing plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track finances; Beancount users must write syntax by hand and view summaries outside the vault.
summary: Beancount-based personal finance manager that tracks accounts and transactions in plain-text files with dashboards, goals and filtering.
